Yes, because a new mutation can occur

No, because both parents appear healthy

questions.question: Manifest iron-deficiency anemia does NOT typically manifest as
questions.explanation: Established isolated iron-deficiency anemia is typically microcytic, not macrocytic. Iron studies require interpretation in the inflammatory context.

questions.question: Allogeneic bone marrow transplantation includes
options: Transplantation of cells from a relative
Transplantation of the patient’s own cells
Transplantation of cells from another animal species
Transplantation of cells from an unrelated human donor
questions.explanation: Allogeneic cells come from another person, related or unrelated. Own-cell transplantation is autologous; cross-species transplantation is xenogeneic.

questions.question: Manifestations of primary-hemostasis disorders do NOT typically include
questions.explanation: Mucocutaneous bleeding typifies platelet/VWF disorders; deep-tissue and joint bleeding instead suggests coagulation-factor deficiency.

questions.question: Which is NOT a characteristic manifestation of decompensated liver cirrhosis?

questions.question: Which can cause prolongation of aPTT?

questions.question: Decreased plasma haptoglobin is most suggestive of which listed process?
questions.explanation: Haptoglobin binds free intravascular hemoglobin and is consumed during intravascular hemolysis. Liver dysfunction can also lower it.
